data: Is the average running time of T-TArrk higher than that of biLMsts for the same number of words?

Wait a moment, let me verify this. The caption tells us that the figure shows the average running times of each model according to the number of words on STS and reranking tasks. The lines in the graph represent different models: biLMrrk (dotted blue), T-TArrk (yellow), biLMsts (grey dashed), and T-TAsts (orange). 

Looking at the graph, I can see that for the same number of words, the yellow line (T-TArrk) is consistently above the grey dashed line (biLMsts). This indicates that the average running time of T-TArrk is indeed higher than that of biLMsts for the same number of words.
Yes, the average running time of T-TArrk is higher than that of biLMsts for the same number of words.
